title: Settings Screen
purpose: Application settings organized by category with filtering and MCP server management
states: open-first-group - settings open on first category
open-selected - settings open on specific selected category
acceptance: shall display as modal overlay with backdrop
shall show sidebar with setting group names
shall display settings for selected group in main area
shall support searching/filtering settings by name
shall show MCP panel with extra server management UI
shall close on Escape or close button
shall support keyboard navigation between groups
shall remember last opened group per session
